title: Ashtanga Yoga
one_line: The eight-limbed path that teaches how to make the mind one-pointed so as to see the Universal Self.
points: The word ashtanga means eight limbs, or steps.
The eight limbs are: yama; niyama; asana; pranayama; pratyahara; dharana; dhyana; and samadhi.
Ashtanga yoga is presented as the answer to the question of how the mind can be made one-pointed so that the Universal Self may be seen.
